scope: DLA machine-bolt pricing and buyer-supplier integrity challenge, NSN 5306016864912
principle: Persistent falsifiable inquiry: finding an ordinary explanation or no support is a successful result.

current_evidence_state.document_price: verified current 0.9100 USD per EA; 906 EA; ordered amount 824.46 USD
current_evidence_state.historical_summary: seven exact awards and record arithmetic reconciled; prior terms incomplete

source_required: url or exact public artifact path
saved artifact digest and hash scope
shared_input_contract.unknown_policy: Null and unresolved; never turn missing evidence into false, zero or proof of concealment.
shared_input_contract.privacy: Keep professional roles and business identifiers relevant to procurement. Exclude personal contact, residential, family, private financial data and inferred personal profiles.

agents.work: Resolve physical attributes, revision, materials, thread, finish, origin, sampling, traceability and certificate requirements.
agents.stop: No primary specification or unresolved critical mismatch; ask for the exact missing public record rather than substitute a generic bolt.

inputs: dated public catalogs and executable offers if already available
agents.work: Capture seller terms, pack units, quantity tiers, available quantity, delivery, freight, currency, certification acceptance and upstream source.
agents.output: Benchmark intervals and exclusion reasons with independent-source grouping.
agents.stop: Test-site, unavailable quantity, unconfirmed pack, generic shipment claim or unaccepted compliance terms cannot become a qualified benchmark.

agents.work: Normalize landed unit and full feasible order cost; compute amount-weighted differences by ordered/invoiced/paid basis and uncertainty.
agents.output: Reproducible numbers or blocked result with exact failed fields.
agents.stop: Never infer price from ceiling/estimated volume or cash payment from obligation/order. No arbitrary freight or compliance-cost adjustment.

inputs: full bid abstracts or actual bids
agents.work: Reconstruct bid spreads, acceptability, withdrawals, submissions and repeated outcomes. Test common templates/upstream supply and legitimate specialization before concern escalation.
agents.output: Documented patterns, eligible denominator and alternative explanations.
agents.stop: Offers count alone cannot prove or disprove independence. Do not infer losing bidders from prior winners.

agents.work: Separate procurement roles; link actual decisions to the right office/person as of the event. Test before/after and cross-office patterns with item/terms controls.
agents.output: Dated role-to-decision facts, not speculative influence links.
agents.stop: No adverse label based on signatory, surname, shared geography or later employment alone; no personal or residential investigation.

agents.work: Evaluate whether actual benefit/influence evidence exists and whether a procurement nexus is supported. Date legal status and distinguish allegation from finding.
agents.output: Evidence status with alternative explanations; no numeric kickback unless the source establishes it.
agents.stop: Pricing residuals and public business links alone do not establish benefit, agreement, intent or crime. Nonpublic records require an independently authorized lawful process.

agents.work: Reconstruct arithmetic, inspect source locations, challenge quote selection and model assumptions, run meaningful mutation tests.
agents.output: Accept/narrow/reject/unresolved per claim plus hash-pinned review.
agents.stop: No producer can approve its own qualified premium. Reject conclusions that outrun sources; preserve valid narrow facts.

agents.work: Publish separate fact, hypothesis, benchmark and known-case nodes; pin exact inputs and preserve old review. Provide Claude a bounded record-acquisition task and return schema.
agents.output: Reviewable repository handoff with explicit pending gates.
agents.stop: No automatic complaints, emails, purchases, submissions or publication outside the authorized repository.

workflow.gate: Exact technical/commercial qualification before market premium calculation.
Run price and decision branches independently; neither branch requires assuming wrongdoing.
Separate economic difference, evidence of improper influence, and legal findings; independent falsification.
Publish only reviewed claims with provenance and unresolved fields intact.

bounded_persistence.declared_universe: Seven historical PIIDs plus current parent/order; expansions must specify NSN, office, dates and complete retrieval/coverage rules.
bounded_persistence.rerun_condition: New discriminating source, corrected extraction or failed test; not repeated searching until an accusation appears.
bounded_persistence.unproductive_stop: After the declared acquisition budget, save inaccessible/missing records and the exact next obtainable record. Do not convert public record absence into a finding.
bounded_persistence.renewal: Future work may expand a specified cohort or record type under the root's coordinated scope.

claude_handoff.suggested_task: Acquire/review unrestricted primary item specifications and the actual quoted-price/evaluation record for the seven named solicitations; preserve technical and bid gaps. Do not duplicate catalog discovery or infer a kickback.
required_return: source artifact hashes and minimal public snapshots
claude_handoff.coordination: The root owns repository communication. This file does not claim Claude or another external model was contacted by this agent.
